promises.label: FY26 growth above 20%
promises.quote: We had guided 17% to 18% growth for FY '25-'26... we will definitely cross 20% growth over and above last year.
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: 20%+ CAGR next 3-5 years
promises.quote: next 3 to 5 years, we will be maintaining a 20% plus CAGR growth
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta

promises.label: Sanand Phase 1 operational November 2025
promises.quote: the first phases, which contributes more than 50% to the capacity of the total plant will be operational definitely by in November
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: Sanand Phase 2 delayed ~9 months
promises.quote: Phase 2 is concerned... that is delayed by approximately 9 months
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: Sanand full project revenue ~₹6,000 crore
promises.quote: once full project is completed, we have estimated a revenue of around INR6,000 crores from the whole project
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: EBITDA margin expansion 1-1.5% post Sanand
promises.quote: Definitely, there will be a margin expansion by 1% to 1.5%.
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: Exports ~18% of sales FY27
promises.quote: around 18% of our sales through exports in the next financial year
promises.speaker: Anil Gupta

promises.label: Sanand topline ₹2,000-2,500 crore next year
promises.quote: next year, we are planning to take the topline of more than INR2,000 crores to INR2,500 crores from the Sanand plant
promises.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
